entries.0e11d320cee336a2: This reportable segment consists of the consolidated subsidiary TAKEUCHI MFG.(U.S.),LTD., which manufactures and sells construction machinery. In addition to selling products developed and manufactured by the company to local rental companies and dealers, the company sells crawler loaders, which the U.S. subsidiary completes from work-in-process that the company has assembled to a self-propelled state. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥128,711 million, the largest of the regional segments.
entries.0f42d022717a96e7: Based on the segment note (revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026), the MD&A analysis of the Japan segment, and the description of the business environment in 'Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address.'
entries.1ef1b3b5aff5ab84: The 'Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Address' section states that its strength lies in 'developing, manufacturing and selling small construction machinery of the world's highest quality,' and the 'Business Overview' section shows its main products and the sales format in each region.

The company sells products it has developed and manufactured to local rental companies, dealers and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥17,976 million.

entries.99e0f7f07693d58b: It develops and manufactures mini excavators, hydraulic excavators and crawler loaders. Mini excavators are excavators with a machine mass of 0.5 tons or more and less than 6.0 tons; crawler loaders are loading, hauling and excavating machines for uneven terrain. It also handles lithium-ion battery-powered mini excavators.
entries.9b2dd84affeb910d: This reportable segment consists of the consolidated subsidiary Takeuchi Koutei Kikai (Qingdao) Co., Ltd., which manufactures components for construction machinery. Most of the business consists of manufacturing and selling components supplied to the company, and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6 million.
entries.9bf7fb9b2ad95aa8: In North America, it sells through its U.S. subsidiary to local rental companies and dealers, and its major customers include United Rentals, Inc. (U.S. segment; revenue of ¥36,455 million for the fiscal year ended February 2026). In Europe, in addition to sales from its UK and French subsidiaries, it also sells through distributors such as HUPPENKOTHEN GmbH & Co KG in Austria (revenue of ¥24,945 million in the same fiscal year).
entries.a0f99575457d6b14: It is a construction machinery manufacturer headquartered in Sakaki Town, Hanishina District, Nagano Prefecture. It has 4 consolidated subsidiaries: a manufacturing and sales company in the United States, sales companies in the United Kingdom and France, and a parts manufacturing company in China. As of February 28, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 1,366.
entries.b79c49a303839ce7: This reportable segment consists of the consolidated subsidiary TAKEUCHI MFG.(U.K.)LTD., which sells construction machinery.
entries.bf8c24b8745296c6: This reportable segment comprises the company's development, manufacture and sale of construction machinery. Most revenue consists of sales to distributors in Europe, and the company has a distributor agreement with HUPPENKOTHEN GmbH & Co KG of Austria. In Japan, the company supplies products on an OEM basis to domestic manufacturers and sells specialty construction machinery directly to rental companies and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥67,812 million.
entries.ca68586f03f8b576: This reportable segment comprises the company's development, manufacture and sale of construction machinery.
entries.cca9131a37ced0ca: The Fourth Medium-Term Management Plan, covering the fiscal years ended February 2026 to February 2028, carries the slogan 'Building Excellence: High Quality, High Performance, High Engagement, Challenging Consolidated Revenue of ¥300 billion,' and sets as key measures expanding the sales network and aftermarket parts sales, reorganizing production models and building a new crawler loader plant, expanding the lineup of battery-powered mini excavators, investing in human capital, and promoting sustainability management.
entries.d9d5c2303f98fb6f: Of revenue from external customers of ¥225,284 million, the United States accounted for ¥128,711 million, a majority, followed by Japan at ¥67,812 million, the United Kingdom at ¥17,976 million, France at ¥10,776 million and China at ¥6 million. Its main markets are the United States and Europe, and most of the revenue of the Japan segment comes from sales to European distributors. Its products are used in housing-related construction work and in living-infrastructure work such as water pipes, gas pipes and roads.
entries.e7e30aeb7d0798c2: This reportable segment consists of the consolidated subsidiary TAKEUCHI MFG.(U.S.),LTD., which manufactures and sells construction machinery.
entries.e80a42e4e0ddd716: Its distinguishing feature is that it focuses on small construction machinery centered on mini excavators and crawler loaders, with the group handling everything from development through manufacturing to sales. In the United States, a subsidiary carries out the crawler loader work through to completion, while in Europe a structure of sales subsidiaries and distributors has been built.
entries.ec5d371a3a861a7a: This reportable segment consists of the consolidated subsidiary TAKEUCHI FRANCE S.A.S., which sells construction machinery. The company sells products it has developed and manufactured to local rental companies, dealers and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥10,776 million.
entries.f03a59cf6e4b3492: A construction machinery manufacturer headquartered in Sakaki, Nagano Prefecture, that develops and manufactures compact construction machinery such as mini excavators and crawler loaders, and sells them worldwide, mainly in Europe and North America.
entries.fadea970baf50124: This reportable segment consists of the consolidated subsidiary Takeuchi Koutei Kikai (Qingdao) Co., Ltd., which manufactures components for construction machinery.
